summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK-style PDMR (persons discharging managerial responsibilities) notification, the equivalent of a US Form 4 insider transaction report. The filing discloses that the trustee of the HMRC-approved British American Tobacco Share Incentive Plan purchased 3 ordinary shares of 25p each for CEO Tadeu Marroco, CMO Luciano Comin, and Research and Science director James Murphy at 45.325 per share on 4 November 2026, aggregate 135.98 each, on the London Stock Exchange. No strategic event, no board recommendation, and no deal mechanics are involved; this is a routine share-plan purchase notice with no risk-arb angle.
